tooltip.fast-noteblocks.mod_enabled: Master switch for every Fast Noteblocks feature.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.overlays: Chooses which block labels are shown. The overlay key switches this off and restores the last selected mode.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.nearby_previews: Shows all nearby enabled labels. When disabled, a label appears only while aiming at its position.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.interactive_cont: Enables scroll controls for note blocks and repeaters, including the note-selection radial.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.radial_focus_del: Ticks the center label must stay under the crosshair before its radial opens and accepts scrolling. 0 opens immediately.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.repeater_control: Radial select shows a four-number diamond and lets either wheel direction confirm a hovered delay. Scroll uses one number with directional cycling.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.invert_scroll: Makes wheel-down raise the selected pitch instead of wheel-up.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.view_distance: Maximum distance at which note and repeater labels are shown.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.interaction_dela: Extra ticks between tuning interactions. 0 restores the original maximum of one interaction per client tick.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.wait_for_ack: Waits for the changed block state to return from the server before sending the next interaction. Safer on restrictive or laggy servers, but slower.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.require_line_of_: Cancels tuning if another block obstructs the path from your eyes to the target block. Disabled by default.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.sequence_enabled: Runs or pauses the placement sequence without resetting its position. Double-tap the sequence control key to do the same.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.auto_select_sequ: Before a sequence placement, selects a note block or repeater from your hotbar to match the next step. Missing items leave the click unchanged.
tooltip.fast-noteblocks.sequence: Comma-separated notes from 0 to 24 and repeater delays from 1d to 4d. Example: 0, 2d, 4, 2d, 7.
guide.fast-noteblocks.sequence:
Sequence guide: notes use 0-24; repeaters use 1d-4d. Example: 0, 2d, 4, 2d, 7.
Controls: hold the sequence key to preview; hold and scroll up/down for the previous/next step; double-tap to pause/resume. Manual scrolling stops at either end.
Pitch guide:
0:F♯  1:G  2:G♯  3:A  4:A♯  5:B  6:C  7:C♯  8:D  9:D♯  10:E  11:F
12:F♯  13:G  14:G♯  15:A  16:A♯  17:B  18:C  19:C♯  20:D  21:D♯  22:E  23:F  24:F♯
error.fast-noteblocks.sequence: Use comma-separated notes from 0 to 24 and repeater delays from 1d to 4d.
